title: DAY 7 — LESSON 3: APPLYING TEAMWORK PRINCIPLES TO EVERYDAY SPA OPERATIONS

questions.prompt: What is one of the first ways an employee contributes to teamwork?
options: Completing assigned responsibilities accurately and on time
Waiting for colleagues to complete tasks

questions.prompt: What should reception do before confirming an appointment change?
options: Check the necessary therapist and room availability

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when an assigned room is not ready?
options: Tell the client that colleagues are incompetent
Communicate the issue and coordinate an appropriate solution

questions.prompt: What is essential during a handover?
options: Accurate information about completed and unresolved responsibilities
Avoiding all mention of unfinished tasks
Leaving the next employee to discover problems

questions.prompt: What does the DAILY framework represent?
options: Define, Act, Inform, Lend support, Yield to shared goals
